schema.text: How does the quality of crossings (e.g., signals, bridges, or underpasses) near the stops you use most often influence your sense of safety?

options.text: I avoid some stops because the crossings feel unsafe
I often feel unsafe when crossing to reach the stop
I sometimes change my route to use crossings that feel safer
I generally feel safe, but I still need to be careful when crossing
I feel safe: the crossings are well designed and protected

en.#I often feel unsafe when crossing to re: I often feel unsafe when crossing to reach the stop
en.#I sometimes change my route to use cros: I sometimes change my route to use crossings that feel safer
en.#I generally feel safe, but I still need: I generally feel safe, but I still need to be careful when crossing
How does the quality of crossings (e.g., signals, bridges, or underpasses) near the stops you use most often influence your sense of safety?
en.#I avoid some stops because the crossing: I avoid some stops because the crossings feel unsafe
en.#I feel safe: the crossings are well des: I feel safe: the crossings are well designed and protected

it.#I often feel unsafe when crossing to re: Spesso mi sento in pericolo quando attraverso la strada per raggiungere la fermata
it.#I sometimes change my route to use cros: A volte cambio percorso per utilizzare attraversamenti che mi sembrano più sicuri
it.#I generally feel safe, but I still need: In generale mi sento al sicuro, ma devo comunque prestare attenzione quando attraverso
In che modo la qualità degli attraversamenti (ad es. semafori, ponti o sottopassaggi) vicino alle fermate che usi più spesso influisce sulla tua percezione di sicurezza?
it.#I avoid some stops because the crossing: Evito alcune fermate perché gli attraversamenti mi sembrano pericolosi
it.#I feel safe: the crossings are well des: Mi sento al sicuro: gli attraversamenti sono ben fatti e protetti

fr.#I often feel unsafe when crossing to re: Je me sens souvent en danger lorsque je traverse pour rejoindre l’arrêt
fr.#I sometimes change my route to use cros: Je change parfois d’itinéraire pour utiliser une traversée qui me semble plus sûre
fr.#I generally feel safe, but I still need: En général, je me sens en sécurité, mais je dois rester prudent(e) lorsque je traverse
Comment la qualité des traversées (par ex. feux, passerelles ou passages souterrains) près des arrêts que vous utilisez le plus souvent influence-t-elle votre sentiment de sécurité ?
fr.#I avoid some stops because the crossing: J'évite certains arrêts parce que les traversées me semblent dangereuses
fr.#I feel safe: the crossings are well des: Je me sens en sécurité : les traversées sont bien conçues et protégées

de.#I often feel unsafe when crossing to re: Ich fühle mich beim Überqueren auf dem Weg zur Haltestelle oft unsicher
de.#I sometimes change my route to use cros: Ich ändere manchmal meine Route, um eine Querung zu nutzen, die sich sicherer anfühlt
de.#I generally feel safe, but I still need: Im Allgemeinen fühle ich mich sicher, muss beim Überqueren aber trotzdem vorsichtig sein
Wie beeinflusst die Qualität der Übergänge (z. B. Ampeln, Brücken oder Unterführungen) in der Nähe der Haltestellen, die Sie am häufigsten nutzen, Ihr Sicherheitsgefühl?
de.#I avoid some stops because the crossing: Ich meide manche Haltestellen, weil mir die Übergänge unsicher erscheinen
de.#I feel safe: the crossings are well des: Ich fühle mich sicher: Die Übergänge sind gut gestaltet und geschützt

tr.#I often feel unsafe when crossing to re: Durağa ulaşmak için karşıya geçerken sık sık kendimi güvensiz hissederim
tr.#I sometimes change my route to use cros: Daha güvenli hissettiren geçişleri kullanmak için bazen güzergâhımı değiştiririm
tr.#I generally feel safe, but I still need: Genellikle kendimi güvende hissederim, ancak karşıya geçerken yine de dikkatli olmam gerekir
En sık kullandığınız durakların yakınındaki geçitlerin (ör. trafik ışıkları, üst geçitler veya alt geçitler) kalitesi güvenlik hissinizi nasıl etkiliyor?
tr.#I avoid some stops because the crossing: Geçitler güvensiz geldiği için bazı duraklardan kaçınıyorum
tr.#I feel safe: the crossings are well des: Kendimi güvende hissediyorum: geçitler iyi tasarlanmış ve korunaklı

fa.#I often feel unsafe when crossing to re: هنگام عبور برای رسیدن به ایستگاه اغلب احساس ناامنی می‌کنم
fa.#I sometimes change my route to use cros: گاهی مسیرم را تغییر می‌دهم تا از گذرگاهی استفاده کنم که امن‌تر به نظر می‌رسد
fa.#I generally feel safe, but I still need: در مجموع احساس امنیت می‌کنم، اما هنگام عبور همچنان باید مراقب باشم
کیفیت گذرگاه‌ها (مانند چراغ راهنمایی، پل یا زیرگذر) در نزدیکی ایستگاه‌هایی که بیشتر استفاده می‌کنید چه تأثیری بر احساس امنیت شما دارد؟
fa.#I avoid some stops because the crossing: از برخی ایستگاه‌ها دوری می‌کنم چون گذرگاه‌ها ناامن به نظر می‌رسند
fa.#I feel safe: the crossings are well des: احساس امنیت می‌کنم: گذرگاه‌ها به‌خوبی طراحی شده و محافظت‌شده‌اند

hu.#I often feel unsafe when crossing to re: Gyakran érzem magam bizonytalannak, amikor a megállóhoz vezető úton át kell kelnem
hu.#I sometimes change my route to use cros: Néha módosítom az útvonalat, hogy biztonságosabbnak tűnő átkelőhelyet használjak
hu.#I generally feel safe, but I still need: Általában biztonságban érzem magam, de átkeléskor továbbra is óvatosnak kell lennem
Hogyan befolyásolja a leggyakrabban használt megállók közelében lévő átkelőhelyek (pl. jelzőlámpák, hidak vagy aluljárók) minősége a biztonságérzetét?
hu.#I avoid some stops because the crossing: Egyes megállókat elkerülök, mert az átkelőhelyek nem tűnnek biztonságosnak
hu.#I feel safe: the crossings are well des: Biztonságban érzem magam: az átkelőhelyek jól kialakítottak és védettek

ar.#I often feel unsafe when crossing to re: غالبًا ما أشعر بعدم الأمان عند العبور للوصول إلى المحطة
ar.#I sometimes change my route to use cros: أغيّر طريقي أحيانًا لاستخدام معبر يبدو أكثر أمانًا
ar.#I generally feel safe, but I still need: أشعر بالأمان عمومًا، لكنني ما زلت بحاجة إلى الحذر عند العبور
كيف تؤثر جودة المعابر (مثل الإشارات أو الجسور أو الأنفاق) بالقرب من المحطات التي تستخدمها أكثر على شعورك بالأمان؟
ar.#I avoid some stops because the crossing: أتجنب بعض المحطات لأن المعابر تبدو غير آمنة
ar.#I feel safe: the crossings are well des: أشعر بالأمان: المعابر مصممة جيدًا ومحمية
